title: Set image quality (RAW+JPEG)

steps.text: Hold the QUAL button (rear left column, top)
Spin the rear dial to RAW+FINE — RAW for latitude, JPEG for instant sharing
Spin the front dial for JPEG size — L unless cards are tight

tip: Dual slots: RAW to slot 1, JPEG to slot 2 (Shooting menu → Role played by card in Slot 2).
